proof_body:
by
  intro A B C hA hB hC hs
  have hc := strictConcaveOn_sin_Icc.concaveOn
  have hm : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), (![A, B, C] i) ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi := by
    intro i _
    fin_cases i <;> simp <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have h := hc.le_map_sum (t := Finset.univ) (w := fun _ : Fin 3 => (1 : ℝ) / 3) (p := ![A, B, C])
    (fun _ _ => by norm_num) (by simp) hm
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] at h
  have e : 1 / 3 * A + 1 / 3 * B + 1 / 3 * C = Real.pi / 3 := by linarith
  simp at h
  have e2 : 3⁻¹ * A + 3⁻¹ * B + 3⁻¹ * C = Real.pi / 3 := by linarith
  rw [e2, Real.sin_pi_div_three] at h
  linarith
target_source: ∀ A B C : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < B → 0 < C → A + B + C = Real.pi → Real.sin A + Real.sin B + Real.sin C ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt 3 / 2
